schedule.note: informational; the Task Scheduler entries pass --observers <labels> (config id . variant)

official_forms_basis.forms: lib/natural-task-rules.mjs OFFICIAL_FORMS, read by position as a grammar (Codex 79e624d N1; README lines quoted in docs/provider-shapes/agileworks-readme-forms.md) — P2: command exactly node (a path to it, node.exe), the script = the first argument that is not an option, ending with aw-app/dist/custom/admin/server.js, credentials in the entry's env as ACCESS_TOKEN and SYSTEM_URL; P3: command exactly npx (a path to it, npx.cmd), with -y / --yes left out the first argument exactly mcp-remote (or mcp-remote@<version>, the version a plain tag or semver /^[0-9A-Za-z][0-9A-Za-z.\-]*$/ — an npm alias, git, github:, file: or URL spec is unclear) and the next an http(s) URL whose path ends with /mcp, credentials as --header (or that URL's query) x-access-token and x-system-url. Three values per entry: official / other (no official marker anywhere) / unclear (a marker but not the grammar) — unclear is undetermined, never a false completion. The host of the P3 URL is not bound: the README itself writes {FQDN} (each customer's own host); the pass is bound by mcp-remote, the /mcp path and the two AgileWorks headers x-access-token and x-system-url
official_forms_basis.npm_package: none published (checked 2026-09-29: agileworks-mcp-server, agileworks-mcp, @atled/…, @atled-workflow/… all 404; the internal package name orval-agileworks-mcp is not on npm), so package names are never used as evidence

marker.not_measured: Not configurations (each needs evidence a fixture cannot give): (1) Gemini with Google Search grounding — the Gemini API terms (2026-04-28) forbid collecting or analysing the grounding links programmatically; the tool-less Gemini reading of the two-line form (M-004) is the memory baseline and remains. (2) Perplexity Agent API — its documented structured citation field (output_text.annotations) has not been seen filled on a real response; until it has, a Perplexity row could not tell a cited page from an uncited one (removed 2026-10-02 after Codex review of 79e624d). (3) Claude Code — the isolation of the CLI (no user settings, memory, skills, MCP servers, hooks; only the allowed tools) has not been verified on a real start; a fixture can only show that the harness checks the system/init event it is given (removed 2026-10-02). Their readers and callers are removed from lib/natural-task*.mjs; git history keeps them.
marker.note: M-006 = the natural-task reading of the same seal as M-004 (the official MCP repository URL; sealed again as M-006 with its own fingerprint). No format is appended to the request and no options are shown. Two configurations: OpenAI Responses (web_search) and Anthropic Messages (web_search_20250305 + web_fetch_20250910). THE SHAPE TABLE FIRST (lib/natural-task-rules.mjs SHAPES, written from the providers' documentation copied in docs/provider-shapes/ with the date it was read): one generic checker validates the whole response — top level (OpenAI status completed — an incomplete response is never read: instrument budget when incomplete_details.reason is max_output_tokens, other otherwise —, error absent or null, output an array; Anthropic every turn's content an array and its stop_reason documented, every turn but the last pause_turn, a last pause_turn = instrument budget) and every item of a type the table knows, field by field — before anything is read; anything outside it refuses the whole response (instrument other, no partial trace); a well-formed item of an unknown type is skipped and only its type name is kept, privately. The readers walk the checker's view, which holds only declared fields. DISCOVER = a URL in the structured fetched or cited fields resolves to the sealed repository (sourceRepoKey on each whole URL; page bodies and answer texts are never scanned; candidates from search results are recorded, never counted; a fetch REQUEST counts whether or not its result came back). Citations: OpenAI output_text.annotations[url_citation].url, Anthropic text.citations[web_search_result_location].url; a block without its citation field cites nothing of its own and the other blocks' citations stay. UNDERSTAND = exactly one strict-JSON artifact (a fenced block; a key written twice makes it no artifact) with a top-level mcpServers object, each entry read by the README's two forms as a grammar by position (official_forms_basis), with the official credential slots IN THEIR OWN PLACE; a Basic / API-key style credential anywhere in that entry is a false completion; an entry that carries an official marker but not the grammar is undetermined; no single artifact = undetermined. Exactly one of pass / false_completion / undetermined / instrument is true. Private, never public: the traces, the artifact and the skipped type names go to environment.private.json; the raw responses go to <observer>/transcript.jsonl. Public rows carry booleans, and a model id a provider reports is public only when it matches ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.\-]{0,63}$. The sheet labels and counts rows per configuration (config id + prompt variant + fetch meaning) and gives no figure across configurations.
